meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 它会拉起一个 5 人团队(3 名漏洞猎手 + 2 名 PoC 工程师)并行审计代码:先找可疑漏洞,再实际验证能否利用,按 CWE 归类根因、依可利用性定级,最后给出 PASS / PASS WITH FINDINGS / BLOCK 结论与最小修复建议。
howto.when: 当你提到 “security-research”、“security review”、“vulnerability audit” 等关键词,或要求做发布前安全检查时触发;需已开启 team-mode、处于主会话,并给出具体审计目标(仓库、diff、PR 等)。

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次安全审查
say.note: 启动 5 人团队审计当前仓库

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的改动里有哪些可利用漏洞
say.note: 以 diff 为范围,给出定级和 PoC

say.text: 对发布候选版本做发布前安全检查
say.note: 输出结论、发现与残留风险

howto.what_en: It spins up a 5-member team (3 vulnerability hunters + 2 PoC engineers) to audit a codebase in parallel: hunt candidates, prove or falsify exploitability, classify root causes by CWE, calibrate severity, and return a verdict plus fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "security-research", "security review", "vulnerability audit" and similar requests; requires team-mode tools, the main session, and a concrete target such as a repo, diff, or PR.

say_en.text: Run a security review on this repository
say_en.note: Starts a 5-member team on the current repo

say_en.text: Audit the changes in this PR for exploitable flaws
say_en.note: Scope is the diff; returns severity and PoCs

say_en.text: Do a pre-release security check on this release candidate
